trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum, awarded automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. Treat it as the final step of the roadmap: finish the story, clear the activities and collectibles, then mop up the secrets in stage 5. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; Push Square GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through Gone Fishing, the opening mission of the story. It unlocks as part of normal progression, so simply start the campaign and finish the mission. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; Push Square GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and this chapter trophy pops with the story. No side work is needed, just keep following the main markers. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 of the main story; the name is shown masked on PlayStation exactly as in the data here. Chapter trophies cannot be skipped if you play the campaign in order. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; GameMapa GTA 6 trophy list (conditions cross-checked from PowerPyx and GamesRadar+)

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Work through Chapter 3 to its end and the trophy follows automatically. Keep a rotating manual save as insurance, as you should for the whole story run. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; Push Square GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 of the campaign. By this point the map and most activity types are open, but the chapter trophy itself only asks for story completion. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission to close out the campaign and earn this gold. Save in a separate slot before the finale so you can return to a clean endgame state for the cleanup stages. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; Push Square GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Breakfast Run. Caution: sources checked report no mission replay, so keep a manual save before starting named story missions in case anything goes wrong during it. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; GameMapa GTA 6 trophy list (conditions cross-checked from PowerPyx and GamesRadar+)

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist, a named story mission. Because sources report missions cannot be replayed, save manually before you begin it and do not overwrite that slot until the trophy lands. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; Push Square GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play when it appears in the campaign. Keep a pre-mission manual save, since the sources checked report no mission replay. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish Headliners, one of the named story missions. As with the other named-mission trophies, a manual save beforehand is cheap insurance against a failed attempt. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; GameMapa GTA 6 trophy list (conditions cross-checked from PowerPyx and GamesRadar+)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown during the story. VCIA is the airport, so expect a vehicle-heavy mission; save manually before it starts. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; Push Square GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Keep the same habit as the other named missions: a fresh manual save before you trigger it. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100 percent on the in-game completion checklist. This is the long grind of stage 4: use the game's own checklist and work category by category after the story is done. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; Push Square GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida, such as jumps and other marked stunt challenges. Spread them through your playthrough rather than grinding them all at the end, and track the count in game. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type at least once; sources put the list at nine types, including fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. A natural early trophy while you explore what the game offers. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; GameMapa GTA 6 trophy list (conditions cross-checked from PowerPyx and GamesRadar+)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in every Shooting Range challenge; sources say there are 42 challenges across the ranges. Practise each weapon class and replay challenges freely until the gold score is beaten. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; Push Square GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location; sources list 14 race locations. Learn each course with a practice run, then chase the win once the route is familiar. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; repeats of the same race do not add to the count. Work through the race list district by district and keep a note of which ones you have already won. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; GameMapa GTA 6 trophy list (conditions cross-checked from PowerPyx and GamesRadar+)

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge and beat his catch. Fishing is also one of the activity types for Master of None, so this pairs well with early exploration. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; Push Square GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find an arcade game in the world and play it through to completion once. Any single full completion counts, so pick the shortest cabinet you come across. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's strand by completing his final mission. Do stranger strands as they appear rather than leaving them all for the endgame, so no strand is left behind by story progress. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; GameMapa GTA 6 trophy list (conditions cross-checked from PowerPyx and GamesRadar+)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission to close his strand. Keep progressing his earlier missions whenever they are offered, alongside the main story. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; Push Square GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand with his final mission. As with the other character finales, clear strand steps as they unlock instead of banking them all for later. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full stranger mission strands anywhere in Leonida. The character finale trophies (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) each finish one strand, so those five plus any three others earn this silver. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; Push Square GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission to finish his strand. Work his strand steps as they appear during the story, like the other character finales. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; GameMapa GTA 6 trophy list (conditions cross-checked from PowerPyx and GamesRadar+)

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand by completing his final mission. Keep his earlier missions moving whenever they unlock so the finale is available before your endgame cleanup. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida; sources say there are 18 spots. Caution: one spot is reported missable, so meditate at a spot the moment you find it instead of planning to come back later. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; Push Square GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunting request and bring down the unique animal he asks for. This is a hidden trophy, so do not expect it to show in the list until it pops; hunting also counts toward Master of None. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; GameMapa GTA 6 trophy list (conditions cross-checked from PowerPyx and GamesRadar+)

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collect every card in any three Collectible Card sets. Focus on completing sets one at a time rather than scattering pickups, and sweep an area fully before moving on. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; Push Square GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations around Leonida. Make it a habit whenever you enter a new district or landmark so the count builds naturally during exploration. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's Challenges. Check the challenge list regularly and clear the short ones (driving, combat and exploration tasks) as you travel. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; GameMapa GTA 6 trophy list (conditions cross-checked from PowerPyx and GamesRadar+)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: While playing with your partner, build a four-star wanted level and then lose it completely and escape. Deliberately set this up in a fast car near good escape routes instead of waiting for it to happen by chance. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; Push Square GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row while keeping your wanted level active the whole time. Pick three shops close together, keep moving between them, and do not hide long enough for the heat to drop. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles; getting in a new model is the reliable way to register it. Swap cars often, visit rich and poor districts for different traffic, and check dealerships and docks. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; GameMapa GTA 6 trophy list (conditions cross-checked from PowerPyx and GamesRadar+)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: During one Combat Focus activation, take down five enemies. Set it up in a crowded firefight: line up a group first, then trigger Combat Focus and work through them before it ends. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; Push Square GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: This is a secret trophy and its official description is deliberately vague: it points at VCIA, the airport, and some kind of unscheduled departure, but the exact method was unconfirmed in the sources checked, so no precise step is given here. Experiment around the airport in the endgame and treat any specific method you see elsewhere as unverified. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: A secret trophy whose official description is deliberately vague, joking about Rhinos, the series' tank. The exact method was unconfirmed in the sources checked, so this guide invents no location or step; try it during stage 5 cleanup if you encounter heavy armour. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; GameMapa GTA 6 trophy list (conditions cross-checked from PowerPyx and GamesRadar+)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get away without being detected. Go in quietly, avoid raising an alarm, and leave by a back route rather than the front door. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; Push Square GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults, escaping after each one. Learn one vault's routine first, then repeat the pattern at the others with a getaway vehicle placed before you start. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hold up an armored truck, take the money and escape the response. Bring serious firepower for the doors and guards, and plan the getaway before you open fire. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; GameMapa GTA 6 trophy list (conditions cross-checked from PowerPyx and GamesRadar+)

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore the whole state of Leonida so every area is uncovered. Clear the map region by region, including islands and rural corners, ideally by air for the last patches. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; Push Square GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation run by each gang, so keep track of which gangs you have already hit. Spread these across the map as you unlock new territories during and after the story. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A secret trophy with a deliberately vague official description, pointing at a cocktail somewhere with a view over Ocean Beach. The exact method was unconfirmed in the sources checked, so no specific bar or step is claimed here; try it while exploring Ocean Beach in the cleanup stage. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; GameMapa GTA 6 trophy list (conditions cross-checked from PowerPyx and GamesRadar+)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: This secret trophy's official description is deliberately vague, describing smashing out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact method was unconfirmed in the sources checked, so this guide invents no showroom or routine; experiment during stage 5 if the opportunity appears. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; Push Square GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: A secret trophy whose official description is deliberately vague, naming Kolt & Associates' bowling alley and a follow-through. The exact method was unconfirmed in the sources checked, so no precise action is stated here; visit the alley in the endgame and experiment. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This secret trophy's official description is deliberately vague, hinting only at a partnership with mass appeal. The exact method was unconfirmed in the sources checked, so this guide gives no invented requirement; leave it for stage 5 experimentation with your partner. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; GameMapa GTA 6 trophy list (conditions cross-checked from PowerPyx and GamesRadar+)

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: A secret trophy tied to choices you make, for better or worse. Caution: choice and profile effects in this game are reported to be permanent, so keep rotating manual saves before big decisions so a choice-based outcome stays reachable. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; Push Square GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: A secret trophy whose official description is deliberately vague, suggesting something succeeds on a second attempt. The exact method was unconfirmed in the sources checked, so no event or location is invented here; note it for stage 5 cleanup. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: This secret trophy's official description is deliberately vague, reacting to something strange without naming it. The exact method was unconfirmed in the sources checked, so this guide claims no location or trigger; keep an eye out for odd events while exploring in stage 5. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; GameMapa GTA 6 trophy list (conditions cross-checked from PowerPyx and GamesRadar+)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A secret trophy with a deliberately vague official description, mixing bowling language with a melee drive-by. The exact method was unconfirmed in the sources checked, so no target count or location is invented here; experiment with melee drive-bys during cleanup. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; Push Square GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder Marked Bills through your contacts until 250,000 dollars in total has been earned this way. Feed every batch of marked bills into laundering as you get them so the total builds during stage 4. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative 100,000 dollars in shops of any kind. Vehicles, weapons, clothes and property extras all move the total, so buy what you actually need rather than wasting cash. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; GameMapa GTA 6 trophy list (conditions cross-checked from PowerPyx and GamesRadar+)

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property on the market. This needs serious cash, so it belongs in stage 4 after the money trophies are under way; buy garages as funds allow, cheapest first. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; Push Square GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you find a keeper while working on discovering 100 vehicles, register it on the spot so the two trophies progress together. Sources: Official PS5 trophy list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide and platinum roadmap
